title: Prompt & Template Engine
summary: This module manages the creation and formatting of prompts for language models. It uses a flexible templating engine to convert structured chat messages, model configurations, and tool data into a coherent, token-limited prompt string, including handling for embedded images and dynamic rendering rules.

nodes.label: Structured Chat Messages
nodes.title: Input Chat Messages
nodes.description: Represents incoming chat messages, including user, assistant, system roles, and embedded images or tool calls, provided as input to the prompt generation process.

nodes.label: Model Configuration
nodes.title: Model Settings
nodes.description: Contains model-specific settings such as the prompt renderer to use, context window size, and vision capabilities, guiding how prompts are formatted.

nodes.label: Prompt Templating Engine
nodes.title: Template Execution
nodes.description: Parses and executes Go templates to format chat messages and other data into a final prompt string for the language model. Supports dynamic data injection and conditional logic.

nodes.label: Chat Prompt Renderer
nodes.title: Message Formatting
nodes.description: Formats structured chat messages into a single, coherent prompt string, handling message roles, image placeholders, and context truncation based on model-specific rules.

nodes.label: Tokenization Service
nodes.title: Token Counting & Truncation
nodes.description: An external service responsible for converting text into tokens and counting token lengths, crucial for context window management and truncation during prompt generation.

nodes.label: Formatted Model Prompt
nodes.title: Final Model Input
nodes.description: The final text string, formatted according to the model's template and renderer, ready to be sent to the language model for inference.

nodes.label: Indexed Image Data
nodes.title: Images for Vision Models
nodes.description: Binary image data extracted from messages, indexed and referenced within the rendered prompt string for multimodal models.

nodes.label: Tool Definitions & Calls
nodes.title: Tool Data for Templates
nodes.description: Structured data representing available tools and specific tool calls made within messages, which can be incorporated into the prompt by the templating engine.

nodes.label: Date Utility Functions
nodes.title: Template Date Helpers
nodes.description: Provides helper functions for templates to insert current or past dates into the generated prompt, enhancing dynamic content.

groups.label: Prompt Generation
groups.title: Prompt Generation Logic
groups.description: Components responsible for the core logic of constructing and formatting the final prompt string for the language model.

groups.label: Prompt Data
groups.title: Data Structures for Prompts
groups.description: Data structures and inputs/outputs involved in the prompt generation process.

groups.label: Context Analysis
groups.title: Context Management & Analysis
groups.description: Components that analyze prompt content, primarily for managing context window limits through tokenization.
